title: Towards a Unified Framework of Optimal Input-Side Dimensional Configuration for Deep CTR Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2610.35695v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deep click-through rate (CTR) prediction has achieved substantial success through increasingly expressive feature interaction architectures. However, predictive performance also depends on how input-side information is configured before interaction modeling. Existing studies have shown that selecting informative samples, features, or embedding units can improve prediction accuracy. Nevertheless, they primarily optimize these selection mechanisms independently along a single input-side dimension, overlooking their shared basic form and the inherent dependencies across input levels, thereby limiting the effectiveness of input-side dimensional configuration. To address this issue, we propose OptIDC, a unified framework for Optimal Input-side Dimensional Configuration in deep CTR prediction. OptIDC jointly learns sample, feature, and embedding-unit level configurations within a unified framework by integrating their corresponding selection

translated_title: 迈向深度CTR预测中最优输入侧维度配置的统一框架
translated_abstract: 深度点击率（CTR）预测通过日益强大的特征交互架构取得了显著成功。然而，预测性能还取决于在交互建模之前输入侧信息的配置方式。已有研究表明，选择信息丰富的样本、特征或嵌入单元能够提升预测准确率。然而，这些研究主要在单一输入侧维度上独立优化各选择机制，忽视了它们共同的基本形式以及不同输入层次之间的内在依赖关系，从而限制了输入侧维度配置的有效性。为解决这一问题，我们提出了OptIDC，一个面向深度CTR预测的最优输入侧维度配置统一框架。OptIDC通过整合各维度对应的选择机制，在统一框架内联合学习样本、特征和嵌入单元层面的配置。
tldr: 提出OptIDC统一框架，在深度CTR预测中联合学习样本、特征和嵌入单元三个层面的输入侧维度配置，克服了以往单一维度独立优化的局限。
en_tdlr: We propose OptIDC, a unified framework that jointly learns sample, feature, and embedding-unit level input-side dimensional configurations for deep CTR prediction, overcoming the limitation of independently optimizing a single input-side dimension.
